title: Dental-Line Credits Already Booked After a Tier Drop — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Clause.** Credits already booked on the dental line after a dependent's Dental PPO Plans enrollment ended for loss of eligibility are deducted from the tier-difference credit on a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement. The deduction is taken from the product of the amount per month and the months counted, before anything is added, and that remainder never falls below 0.00.

- When plan-change difference credits on the dental line were booked since the departed dependent's termination month, their total is deducted.
- When none was, but termination credits on the dental line were booked since then, their total is deducted.
- Otherwise nothing is deducted.

A credit counts as booked since the termination month when the whole calendar months from its booking date to the credit date are no more than the whole calendar months from the dependent's termination date to the credit date. Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted: a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it.

**Hypothetical cases** (termination 31 May; credit date 20 August; reference count 2 whole months).
| Dental-line credits on the ledger | Deducted |
|---|---|
| plan-change difference credit 48.55 booked 15 July | 48.55 |
| termination credit 30.00 booked 2 August, no plan-change difference credit | 30.00 |
| both of the above | 48.55 |
| plan-change difference credit 48.55 booked 10 April (4 whole months before the credit date) | nothing |
